reason: We already have the zoo for free, and a play cafe is a drive for us so gas adds up on top of $12 a visit. $59 a month only pays off if we go five or more times, and I can't promise that.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so the real cost per visit is well above the sticker price. I'd be paying monthly for a place I might only get to a couple of times.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, plus Wi-Fi and seating good enough that I can get real work done, and a location that's an easy short drive from us.
